notes: Complete list: 67 actions (actions.js compileActionDefinitions) and 19 feedbacks (feedbacks.js compileFeedbackDefinitions). Both are returned as one literal object; nothing is generated per cue. Feedbacks are registered only when the connection uses TCP (qlabfb.js init_feedbacks sets an empty list otherwise); actions are always registered.

Protocol: OSC to QLab 4 or 5, UDP or TCP (config checkbox 'Use TCP?', default true; required for feedbacks and variables). Config fields (config.js): Target Host/IP, Target Port (textinput, regex Regex.PORT, default 53000), Use TCP?, Use Tenths?, Expose cue name variables?, OSC Passcode (almost always required for QLab 5), Workspace (dropdown, default 'default', plus the workspaces QLab reports) and Cue List (dropdown, default 'default'). Variables and presets are not catalogued.

Cue selection pattern: many actions and feedbacks share the options Scope (dropdown), Cue Number (q_num) and Cue ID (q_id). The cue fields are shown only for the matching scope (visibleWhen). The scope lists differ: CUE_SCOPE (D Playhead, S Selected, N Cue Number, I Cue ID), FB_SCOPE (D Playhead/Next, R Running Cue(s), N, I), SSP_SCOPE (D Default (All), S Selected, N, I) and a two-entry N/I list; see the per-entity choices. The legacy actions (goto, start, stop_cue, ... *_id) take the cue number or ID in a plain text field.

The source default of every cue number or cue ID field is computed from the playhead cue at definition time (self.wsCues[self.nextCue]?.qNumber, .uniqueID or self.nextCue) and is therefore empty without a loaded workspace; it is not recorded as a default. In the feedbacks q_bg_color, q_armed, q_flagged, q_paused and q_running the cue number default expression reads the property q_num (or self[self.nextCue]?.q_num, self.nextCue.q_num), which the cue objects of cues.js do not have (they use qNumber), so it never yields a value.

On/off style dropdowns use the numeric ids 1 (On), 0 (Off) and, for actions, 2 (Toggle), exactly as in choices.js TOGGLE and ON_OFF. The Continue Mode choices have string ids '0', '1', '2' (choices.js CONTINUE_MODE) and the action 'continue' has no default. The feedbacks min_go (goMode) and ws_mode (showMode) have string ids '0'/'1' and '0'/'1'/'2' with string defaults '1'.

Regex values: the source uses Regex.NUMBER and Regex.SIGNED_FLOAT of @companion-module/base. The recorded strings are the values from @companion-module/base 1.15.0 (enums.js); the module locks 1.12.1 (yarn.lock), whose values were not inspected.

The source also sets a 'length: 2' on the Hour and Minute text inputs (no schema field) and the 'preset' property in the OVERRIDE choices (used by presets only); neither is recorded. Style defaults (defaultStyle) of boolean feedbacks are not recorded.

The 'Master Override' choices (Midi Input, Midi Output, MSC, SysEx, OSC Output, Timecode, Art-Net, DMX, network) carry the QLab version they apply to in the label ([4], [5], [4, 5]); the list is one fixed list for the action and the feedback.
Actions marked 'QLab 5 ONLY' or 'QLab5 only' in their description are registered unconditionally (compileActionDefinitions has no version check).
The module is on @companion-module/base ^1.8.0 (1.x), so option values are not expressions. Not tested against QLab or Companion.
